description: Hand-authored fully synthetic retrieval corpus for Golden Set v1. Every name, product, number and policy is fictional. It models the TEXT LAYER available to retrieval after parsing/extraction (including linearized multi-column / table / OCR text); it is not an OCR or PDF-layout model benchmark.

chunks.text: This synthetic runbook covers the quixbuckle latch procedure. To roll back ZephyrFlow 7400 firmware, press the recessed quixbuckle latch on the controller front panel and hold it for ten seconds while power cycling the controller.
After a successful rollback, the amber lumenvane indicator blinks twice. ZephyrFlow 7400 controllers use firmware channel zf-stable-7400; do not switch to the zf-beta channel during a rollback.
If the rollback fails three times in a row, call the synthetic network operations desk at extension 44170 and quote ticket prefix ZFROLL.

documents.title: 园区食堂泔水与浪费公示制度（虚构）

chunks.text: 本制度为虚构文本。每餐供餐结束后，食堂值班经理须对各档口的泔水桶逐桶称重，并将重量录入后勤公示系统，次日在食堂入口屏公示称重结果。
对连续三日浪费率超过百分之八、情节严重的档口，后勤中心将对档口负责人作约谈处理，责令其停业整顿并提交整改清单，同时核减该档口次月的备餐配额。

documents.title: 考勤与加班管理制度（虚构）

chunks.text: 本制度为虚构文本。员工加班须至少提前四小时在考勤系统提交加班申请，未经审批通过的加班时长不计入调休。
连续旷工达三个工作日的，视为严重违反劳动纪律，公司可依据劳动合同的约定解除劳动关系。

documents.title: XK-2200 工业网关多栏规格表（虚构）

Dense retrieval maps passages into embedding vectors and tends to match paraphrased questions even when no keyword overlaps.
Hybrid search combines lexical BM25 rankings with vector similarity through reciprocal rank fusion, often shortened as RRF.
When a model deployment regresses evaluation metrics, operators roll back to the previous model snapshot before rerunning the suite.
